unify_arch_def: unify an architecture definition dict by parsing block configs, expanding repeats, and flattening stages into a normalized list
build_blocks: build a PyTorch nn.Sequential module from a list of unified block configuration dicts with specified input channels
build_block: build a single neural network block from a block operation name and configuration dict using registered primitives
expand_repeats: expand repeated block configurations into individual blocks with stride 1 for all repeats after the first
count_strides: calculate the cumulative stride product across all blocks in a unified architecture definition
